chapters.title: Ich habe dir eine Nachricht geschickt
chapters.focus: Nachricht + schicken + sent-message Perfekt review + dir

chapters.title: Warum hast du nicht geantwortet?
chapters.focus: antworten + warum + missing-reply question + Ich hatte keine Zeit.

chapters.title: Sag mir bitte Bescheid
chapters.focus: Bescheid + sagen + Sag mir bitte Bescheid. + Ich sage dir Bescheid.

chapters.title: Dann sprechen wir morgen
chapters.focus: communication synthesis + tomorrow call + Bis morgen + A2 completion

pedagogy: A2 Module 08 is complete. The learner can postpone a call, send and discuss a message, ask why someone did not reply, explain lack of time, ask for a short update, promise to give one, and arrange a concrete call for tomorrow.

completionSummary.Series076: postpone a call and ask to call later
completionSummary.Series077: send a message and ask whether it was read
completionSummary.Series078: ask why there was no reply and give a simple reason
completionSummary.Series079: ask someone to let you know and promise to do so
completionSummary.Series080: set a call for tomorrow, close naturally with Bis morgen, and complete A2
